DELETE FROM users
WHERE age BETWEEN 30 AND 40
AND registration_date < '2020-01-01'
AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchases WHERE user_id = users.id) >= 5
AND (SELECT SUM(value) FROM purchases WHERE user_id = users.id) > 200;
